info.title: Lurus API V2 - Multi-Tenant Gateway
info.description:
Lurus API V2 provides multi-tenant access to LLM API gateway services.

## Authentication

V2 authenticates through OpenID Connect. Which provider, which issuer and
which client id are deploy-time configuration, not part of this contract:
the console redirects to whatever provider the deployment was given.

1. Redirect the user to `GET /api/v2/{tenant_slug}/auth/login`
2. The user authenticates with the deployment's configured OIDC provider
3. The provider calls back to `GET /api/v2/oauth/callback`
4. Later requests carry the session cookie, or a bearer token for the
   machine callers that hold one (`OIDCBearer` below)

## Tenant Isolation

All tenant-specific endpoints are scoped by `{tenant_slug}` in the URL path.
Users can only access data within their assigned tenant.

## Rate Limiting

- Every route below `/api/v2` sits behind one shared bucket: 600 requests
  per 180 s per source IP (`middleware.GlobalV2RateLimit`,
  api-v2-router.go). It is keyed by the client address, NOT by account or
  session, so everybody behind one NAT or CGNAT egress address spends the
  same budget - an office on a single public address shares one bucket.
- Those numbers are the shipped defaults. An operator retunes them with
  `GLOBAL_V2_RATE_LIMIT` and `GLOBAL_V2_RATE_LIMIT_DURATION`, so the limit
  a given deployment enforces may differ.
- A limit of 0 DISABLES the bucket; it does not mean unlimited. To turn the
  limiter off deliberately, set `GLOBAL_V2_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLE=false`.
- A reject is `429` with `Retry-After`, `X-RateLimit-Limit`,
  `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Scope: ip`,
  `X-RateLimit-Type: requests`, and an empty body.
- Individual routes may add a narrower bucket of their own on top of this
  one - see the 429 on `POST /api/v2/{tenant_slug}/redeem`.
- Relay traffic is metered by quota, not by this bucket.

get.description:
Redirects to the configured OIDC provider's login page. A PKCE challenge is sent only when OIDC_ENABLE_PKCE=true, which is off by default.
After successful authentication, user is redirected to callback URL.

parameters.name: redirect_url
parameters.description: URL to redirect after successful login

302.description: Redirect to the OIDC provider's login page

Location.description: Authorization URL at the configured OIDC provider

get.description:
Handles the OAuth callback from the configured OIDC provider.
Exchanges authorization code for tokens and creates session.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code issued by the OIDC provider

302.description: Redirect to original URL with session established

get.description: Returns current user session data for frontend

post.description: Logs out at the OIDC provider and clears the session

302.description: Redirect to the OIDC provider's logout URL

get.description: Returns the current authenticated user's profile
Lists all available LLM provider channels

post.description: Creates a new LLM provider channel (Admin only)

get.description: Gets a specific channel by ID

Paginated model catalogue with a whitelist projection. This is NOT the
OpenAI /v1/models envelope - that one belongs to the relay surface and is
documented in relay.json.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Substring match on the model name

400.description: Missing tenant slug or invalid pagination

get.description: Tenant-admin read of the decision-routing policy for one public model. The tenant is always the caller's own; another tenant's policy is simply not found.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Public model name (a single path segment; names containing '/' cannot be addressed).

404.description: No policy for this model (error_code POLICY_NOT_FOUND)

put.summary: Create or Replace Decision Routing Policy
put.description: Creates or replaces the policy for one public model (tenant admin). Candidates: 1-32, criteria at most 2048 bytes each, instructions at most 4096 bytes, min_confidence within [0, 1] (omitted = 0.65). Every candidate model must be routable by the tenant. The change is audited as routing.policy_set.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Public model name (a single path segment; names containing '/' cannot be addressed).

400.description: Validation failure; error_code is one of INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_MODEL, INVALID_MIN_CONFIDENCE, INSTRUCTIONS_TOO_LONG, INVALID_EVALUATOR, EVALUATOR_REQUIRED, INVALID_CANDIDATES, INVALID_CANDIDATE_ID, DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE, INVALID_CANDIDATE_MODEL, MODEL_NOT_ROUTABLE, INVALID_CRITERIA, CRITERIA_TOO_LONG, INVALID_DEFAULT_CANDIDATE, DEFAULT_CANDIDATE_REQUIRED. The policy is validated as a whole; nothing is written on failure.

delete.description: Removes the policy; the public model then routes without a decision step. Audited.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Public model name (a single path segment; names containing '/' cannot be addressed).

404.description: No policy for this model (error_code POLICY_NOT_FOUND)

get.description:
p50/p95 latency and error rate per model over the last `hours`, for
the caller's tenant only (cached per pod for 5 minutes). Every member
gets the quality fields; tenant admins also get the volume fields
(requests, errors, total_tokens, quota, latency_samples).
`enough_samples` is false below `min_samples` latency samples — the
percentiles are then noise, not a measurement.
Lists all API tokens for the current user

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Set to tenant (tenant admin only) to list every token of the tenant, adding user_id, owner_name and content_retention per item; also accepts user_id, project_id, status and keyword filters.

201.description: Token created (includes full key, only shown once)

get.description: Lists the caller's own saved chat sessions, most-recently-updated first.

post.description: Saves a conversation the client already holds — the request carries the full turn array, not a single new turn to append.

400.description: Bad request — error_code is CHAT_SESSION_LIMIT_REACHED (the caller already owns 200 sessions in this tenant) or INVALID_REQUEST (oversized/invalid title, model, or messages).

get.description: Fetches one saved chat session (plus its messages) the caller owns.

patch.description: Partially updates title and/or model, and/or REPLACES the full message list, of a chat session the caller owns.

400.description: Bad request — error_code is INVALID_REQUEST (oversized/invalid title, model, or messages). A rejected update leaves the stored session unchanged.

delete.description: Deletes a chat session (and its messages) the caller owns.

get.description:
Monthly spend buckets for the calling user inside this tenant. Both query
parameters are optional; the range is always clamped to at most 12 calendar
months. There is deliberately no amount_usd field - no FX source is wired
into this endpoint.

mtd_quota.description: Billable quota in the current UTC calendar month

get.description: Tenant monthly statement grouped by project, employee, token or model. The month is a calendar month in the requested time zone. Tenant admins see the whole tenant; department leads see only their own projects (the unassigned project 0 bucket is hidden). format=csv exports the same statement for the whole tenant. Totals are exactly the sum of the rows. Amounts are in 0.0001 CNY.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Calendar month, YYYY-MM (default is the current month in tz)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: csv returns a text/csv download of the whole tenant statement (same grouping, month and totals row)

403.description: Neither tenant admin nor department lead

get.description: Lists user's top-up history
Gets usage logs for the current user
Gets all users' logs (Admin only)

post.description:
Redeems a redemption code and credits the quota to the calling user.
Mounted at /api/v2/{tenant_slug}/redeem (api-v2-router.go), NOT under the
/redemptions collection. Guarded by a 5-requests-per-60-seconds per-IP
limiter because the code itself is the only credential.

schema.description: Send the 32-character code as either key or code; key wins when both are present.

400.description: Missing or malformed code, or the code is unusable (expired, already used, unknown). Body carries success=false, message and error_code.

429.description: Redemption rate limit exceeded. middleware.RedemptionRateLimit (rate-limit.go) allows 5 attempts per 60 s per client IP in the RD bucket, because the code itself is the only credential and an unthrottled run is code guessing. The reject carries the headers below and an EMPTY body - the limiter writes a bare status, not a JSON envelope, so a client must branch on the status code, not on `success`. If Redis is unreachable this bucket degrades to a process-local limiter rather than failing open, which makes the effective ceiling (replicas x 5) per 60 s until Redis returns. The wider /api/v2 bucket described in info.description applies first.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until this IP's redemption window frees a slot.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Attempts allowed per window. 5 for this bucket.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Attempts left in the window. Always 0 on a reject.

X-RateLimit-Scope.description: What the bucket is keyed by. Always `ip` here.

X-RateLimit-Type.description: What is being counted. Always `requests` here.

get.description: Lists all redemption codes (Admin only)

post.description: Creates a new redemption code (Admin only)

get.description: Lists all tenants (Platform Admin only)

post.description: Creates a new tenant (Platform Admin only)

get.description: Gets a tenant by ID (Platform Admin only)

post.description: Issues one key per employee of a roster. Tenant admin only. At most 500 items, all-or-nothing in one transaction. Idempotent per employee_ref: an employee that already has a live key is reported under skipped and not re-issued. The plaintext keys of newly created tokens appear in this response only. Keys are owned by the tenant payer (409 payer_not_set when none is configured) and are never trusted-gateway keys.

200.description: Every employee already had a key; nothing created

400.description: Invalid item (error_code TOKEN_BATCH_INVALID) or too many items

409.description: employee_ref conflict, or the tenant has no payer (error_code payer_not_set)

get.description: Lists the members (department leads) of a project. Tenant admin only; a project of another tenant is 404.

post.description: Adds a user to a project; a user with no tenant role becomes dept_lead. Idempotent. Tenant admin only. Not available in the shared default tenant (403 TENANT_ROLE_FORBIDDEN_IN_DEFAULT).

404.description: Project or user not found in this tenant

delete.description: Removes a user from a project; a dept_lead left with no projects is demoted. user_id is read from the query string, or from a JSON body.

404.description: Project or user not found in this tenant

post.description: Mints a one-time onboarding code for the caller's own tenant, optionally granting a role and project membership on redeem. ttl_hours defaults to 72, maximum 720. Tenant admin only. The full code is returned only here.

404.description: Project not found in this tenant

get.description: Lists the tenant's invites, newest first, as a prefix-only projection (never the full code). Tenant admin only.

post.description: Applies an invite's role and project grant to the already logged-in caller. Only a code of the caller's own tenant redeems; a foreign or unknown code is indistinguishable (404 INVITE_NOT_FOUND) and a foreign code is not consumed. Expired and revoked codes answer 410, a spent code 409.

delete.description: Revokes a pending invite of the caller's own tenant. Another tenant's invite id and a spent or already revoked one are both 404. Tenant admin only.

get.description: Members of the caller's own tenant with role, payer flag and department memberships. Tenant admin only. Filter by role (admin, dept_lead, member) and keyword.

400.description: role is not admin, dept_lead or member

put.description: Sets a member's tenant role (admin, dept_lead or empty) in the caller's own tenant. Tenant admin only. Refuses to leave the tenant without an admin (409 LAST_TENANT_ADMIN). The payer flag is root-only and ignored here. Not available in the shared default tenant.

404.description: User is not a member of this tenant

get.description: The tenant's own audit trail, newest first. Every query is pinned to the caller's tenant; a tenant_id query parameter is ignored. Details are redacted (channel ids, upstream keys, internal notes). Tenant admin only.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Audit action name; unknown names are 400

get.description: CSV export of the tenant's audit trail, one page per call. When more rows remain the response carries X-Next-Cursor; pass it back as cursor. Same filters, scoping and redaction as the list. Tenant admin only; rate limited.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Audit action name; unknown names are 400

get.description: Shows the platform-granted model ceiling, the tenant's own narrowing selection and the effective list. Tenant admin only.

put.description: Narrows the models the tenant may use. Every entry must be covered by the platform ceiling when one is configured (403 MODEL_NOT_GRANTED); an empty list is an explicit deny-all; selected_models is required. The change reaches every replica within propagation_seconds. Tenant admin only; audited.

400.description: selected_models missing or an invalid entry

403.description: Not a tenant admin, or MODEL_NOT_GRANTED

put.description: Root bootstrap of a tenant's first admin or payer. The user must belong to the addressed tenant (404 otherwise). Same body and error codes as the tenant route, plus the optional payer flag.

get.description: Reads the relay-content retention setting of the caller's own tenant: the platform default, the tenant override and the effective mode (Tenant admin only).

put.description: Sets the tenant retention mode. A tenant may tighten past the platform default but never loosen below it (400 RETENTION_CANNOT_LOOSEN). Audited.
Sets the retention mode of one token of the caller's tenant; it may not be looser than the tenant's effective mode. A token of another tenant answers 404. Audited.

get.description: Reads the caller's tenant consent to archive prompt/response bodies (Tenant admin only). Default false. Consent alone archives nothing: the tenant's effective content retention must also be full.

put.description: Turns body archiving on or off for the caller's tenant. A body is archived only when every condition holds: consent is on, the effective content retention is full, the serving channel is not zero-retention, the caller did not send provider.data_collection=deny, the user's log detail level is not none, and the request format is covered by the content rules. Stored request bodies are the post-content-rule (masked) ones, capped at 64KB per field. Audited.

get.description: Streams the caller's logs. format=csv (default) is the spreadsheet export; format=jsonl writes one JSON object per line in ascending id order and is resumable: pass the id of the last line back as cursor. A page shorter than limit is the last one (the X-Next-Cursor trailer carries the same id). include_body=true (jsonl only, Tenant admin only) attaches the archived prompt/response of each row that has one under "body"; each attached body is audited like a direct read.

parameters.description: jsonl only. Id of the last row of the previous page; 0 or absent starts from the oldest.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: jsonl only. Page size (alias max_rows). Default 10000, capped at 50000.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: tenant = every member's rows (Tenant admin only)
parameters.name: scope

200.description: CSV, or newline-delimited JSON (one log row per line, see LogExportRow)

get.description: Platform usage-log export across tenants (Platform Admin only). format=csv (default) or jsonl; jsonl adds cursor/limit paging by id and include_body=true to attach archived bodies (audited). content and the raw other blob are never exported.

200.description: CSV, or newline-delimited JSON (see AdminLogExportRow). X-Total-Matched and X-Truncated describe the whole filter.

get.description: Reads the archived prompt/response of one request of the caller's own tenant (Tenant admin only). A request id that is unknown, expired, never archived or owned by another tenant answers the same 404 LOG_BODY_NOT_FOUND. Every successful read is audited.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The request id carried in logs.other.request_id

get.description: Platform-staff read of an archived prompt/response of any tenant by request id (Platform Admin only). Missing and expired answer 404 LOG_BODY_NOT_FOUND. Audited.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The request id carried in logs.other.request_id

get.description: Lists the caller's tenant content rules plus the built-in pattern names and the per-scope limits.

post.description: Creates a content rule for the caller's own tenant (the tenant is never read from the body). 409 RULE_LIMIT when the per-scope cap is reached. Audited.

put.description: Updates a rule of the caller's tenant; an id belonging to another tenant or to the platform scope answers 404 RULE_NOT_FOUND. Audited.

delete.description: Deletes a rule of the caller's tenant; cross-tenant ids answer 404. Audited.

post.description: Bulk-imports upstream keys. dry_run defaults to true: the response lists per-item status (ready, duplicate, invalid, probe_failed) with a key fingerprint, never the key. With dry_run=false the ready items are written, either as a new multi-key channel (type) or appended to channel_id (which must belong to the caller's tenant, else 403). At most 500 items. Audited.

get.description: Every channel of the caller's tenant over the last 30 days: requests, errors, tokens, quota and cost; plan-fee channels carry a utilization ratio and an idle/overuse verdict and sort first.
Usage of one channel per upstream key index plus the channel total, over the window. A channel of another tenant answers 403.

Health roll-up of every channel of the tenant in one call: routable flag, reasons, earliest expiry, highest plan-quota window usage and cooldown. Derived from the same function as the single-channel health view. Platform staff only; capped at 5000 channels (truncated=true when cut).

Why a channel can or cannot route right now: the routable flag, machine-readable reasons, the cooldown and per-key health. Key material is never returned, only fingerprints. A channel of another tenant answers 403.

post.description: Probes one upstream key (egress and key proxy pass the SSRF guard). When the probe passes and the key is currently blocked, the response carries a short-lived restore_proof bound to the blocked state. Audited.
Lifts the block on one key, only when the proof from the key test still matches the key's current state (409 proof_stale otherwise). Audited.

put.description: Per-key proxy override (validated by the SSRF guard), weight (0-100, 0 = never picked), name, plan kind, expiry and tags. Needs a multi-key channel. Audited.

get.description: Anonymous per-model availability (operational, degraded or down) derived from platform-shared channel state. No channel, account or upstream detail is exposed. Cached for 30 seconds.
Lists platform-scope content rules (Platform Admin only).

post.description: Creates a platform-scope rule (scope is fixed server-side). Audited.

put.description: Updates a platform-scope rule; a tenant rule id answers 404. Audited.

get.description: Lists reusable param/header override templates (Platform Admin only).

put.description: Updates a template and bumps its version; channels already carrying an older application are not rewritten until it is applied again. Audited.

get.description: Append-only log of which channels this template was written into, newest first. Platform staff only.

post.description: Applies a template to the listed channels (bulk, per-channel results; one missing channel does not abort the rest). Audited.

OIDCBearer.description: Bearer token issued by the deployment's configured OIDC provider. Which provider that is, is deploy-time configuration; no specific vendor is part of this contract.

TenantSlug.name: tenant_slug
TenantSlug.description: Tenant identifier (slug). On routes behind TenantSlugGuard the reserved value `~` means "the tenant this session authenticated into"; the server resolves it from the session, and it is what the console sends. An explicit slug must equal that tenant (403 TENANT_MISMATCH otherwise). `GET /user/me` reports the real slug as `tenant_slug`.

KeyIndex.name: idx
KeyIndex.description: Zero-based index of the upstream key inside a multi-key channel

ChannelConfigInvalid.description: Invalid request body. Includes a channel config document (param_override, header_override, model_mapping, or setting) that failed save-time validation, in which case the body carries a code identifying which field.

id.description: 1-64 characters of letters, digits, '_', '.', '-'; unique within the policy; the reserved no-preference id is refused.

model.description: A public model this tenant can route (1-128 bytes).

criteria.description: Natural-language criteria for choosing this candidate (required, at most 2048 bytes).

evaluator_model.description: Decision model that scores the candidates (at most 128 bytes). Required to enable a policy.

instructions.description: Admin-authored prose for the evaluator (at most 4096 bytes).

min_confidence.description: Omitted means 0.65. Below this confidence the default candidate is used.

default_candidate.description: One of the candidate ids; required when the public model is not itself a candidate.

ChannelConfigValidationError.description: 400 body for POST/PUT channel. code is present only when the request body's param_override (structural pre-pass + dry-run of the relay override engine), header_override, model_mapping, or setting document (shape validators) failed save-time validation; it is absent for other 400s on this endpoint (missing required field, malformed request JSON, etc).

tenant_role.description: The caller's tenant role; empty for plain members and in the shared default tenant

is_payer.description: True when the caller is the tenant's payer

InvoiceMonth.description: One calendar month of billable spend.

amount_cny.description: Amount charged for the month in CNY: the wallet charge recorded at settlement for each request that has one (logs.charged_cny4), the record-time price (logs.priced_cny4) for billable rows the wallet did not pay (credit-pool / local-quota spend), and only for rows that carry neither record the quota priced at the current exchange rate (QuotaPerUnit / USDExchangeRate quota per CNY). Changing the exchange rate re-prices only that last share; see estimated.

estimated.description: True when part of amount_cny was priced at the current exchange rate because some billable row predates logs.priced_cny4 (migration 042); that part changes when the rate is edited. False means every row carries a recorded figure and the amount is final.

unbilled_quota.description: Quota logged but excluded from billing (settlement-failed or channel-test rows)

unbilled_request_count.description: Number of log rows excluded from billing

ModelCatalogEntry.description: Whitelist projection of a catalogue model row.

vendor.description: Vendor display name, empty when unknown

model_limits.description: Comma separated model list; empty = no limit

key.description: Plaintext key, returned only in this response

skipped.description: Employees that already had a live key; not re-issued

code.description: One-time onboarding code; the full value is returned only when the invite is created (list responses carry code_prefix)

TenantInviteView.description: List projection: the code prefix only, never the full code

payer.description: Root route only: mark this user as the tenant payer (owner of admin-issued keys). Ignored on the tenant route.

TenantAuditEvent.description: Tenant-safe projection of an audit event: no hash chain, details redacted (channel ids, upstream keys and internal notes are masked)

platform_allowed.description: Ceiling granted by the platform (names or trailing-* patterns)

platform_unrestricted.description: True when the platform configured no ceiling

propagation_seconds.description: Present on PUT: upper bound before every replica serves the new list

consent.description: Tenant consent to archive prompt/response bodies; default false

LogExportRow.description: One line of the tenant JSONL export. Same columns as the CSV plus id, request_id and channel_key_idx.

channel_key_idx.description: Upstream key index of a multi-key channel; null otherwise

charged_cny.description: CNY to 4 decimals; empty when nothing was recorded

AdminLogExportRow.description: One line of the platform JSONL export (content/other are never included).

LogExportBody.description: Archived body attached under include_body=true; absent when the row has none.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds; LOG_BODY_RETENTION_DAYS after creation (default 30). Past this the body reads as absent.

request_body.description: Request body after the content rules ran (masked), at most 64KB

response_text.description: Final assistant text of a non-streaming response, at most 64KB; empty when response_captured is false

response_captured.description: false when the relay path did not hand the response text over (streaming, or a provider that does not)

truncated.description: true when either text field was cut at 64KB

effective.description: Mode in force: the strictest of the layers

channel_id.description: Append to this multi-key channel of the caller's tenant

type.description: Channel type for a new channel (required without channel_id)

keys.description: Newline-separated keys, or a JSON array text
